## Install

Claude Code:

```
/plugin marketplace add SimonFoote-greensparx/d365forge
/plugin install change-adoption@d365forge
```

ChatGPT and Codex: add this repository as a plugin marketplace, or copy this folder into `.agents/skills/` in your project.

## Skills

| Skill | What it covers | Status |
|---|---|---|
| [`change-adoption:adoption-metrics`](skills/adoption-metrics/SKILL.md) | Defines adoption metrics for Dynamics 365 CE across usage, data quality and process outcomes, with baselines, targets, sources and review rhythm, reported by team or role and never used to monitor individual performance. Use when setting adoption KPIs, specifying an adoption dashboard, or diagnosing low usage after go-live. | reviewed |
| [`change-adoption:communications-plan`](skills/communications-plan/SKILL.md) | Plans change communications for a Dynamics 365 CE rollout by audience, message, sender, channel and timing, from early awareness through go-live and hypercare into release waves, with a feedback loop. Use when drafting the communications calendar, writing go-live announcements, or deciding who should send which message to which group. | reviewed |
| [`change-adoption:role-based-training`](skills/role-based-training/SKILL.md) | Builds a role-based training plan for Dynamics 365 CE from security roles and future-state processes, defining curricula, formats, training environment, materials and schedule per role. Use when designing the training approach, preparing train-the-trainer, setting up a training environment, or planning training for new joiners and release waves. | reviewed |
| [`change-adoption:stakeholder-analysis`](skills/stakeholder-analysis/SKILL.md) | Identifies stakeholder groups for a Dynamics 365 CE rollout and assesses change impact by role across process, system, data, reporting and ways of working, to size the change effort and target engagement. Use when starting change planning, assessing how ready a business unit is, or building a change impact assessment for a phase or module. | reviewed |
| [`change-adoption:super-user-network`](skills/super-user-network/SKILL.md) | Designs and runs a super-user network for Dynamics 365 CE, covering the role, selection from declared skills and availability, agreed time commitment, enablement, and their part in testing, training, hypercare and release waves. Use when recruiting super users, defining their responsibilities, or keeping the network active after go-live. | reviewed |
